  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The SUPERSEDED header treats a cancelled smoke test plus any newer run of the workflow as proof that the newer run cancelled this run's e2e-smoke-test, without checking that the newer run shares the `e2e-smoke-test-<test_repo>` concurrency group or caused the cancellation.
  WHY: A manual cancel, or a newer run with a different `test_repo`, produces a wrong-cause header that misdirects triage (message accuracy only, since nothing was released either way). All four reviewers rated this NIT, which is mapped to low. Confidence ranged from 3 to 4.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~7440-7460 | severity=low (NIT) | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The SUPERSEDED header treats a cancelled smoke test plus any newer run as proof that the newer run cancelled this run's e2e-smoke-test. The code never checks that the newer run took the concurrency slot.
  WHY: A manual cancel, or a newer run with a different `test_repo`, produces the same header. The header then names the wrong cause, although "nothing was released" remains true.
- HARDENING (not a defect): add one comment above the new `gh api` call (~7436-7440) saying the notify job makes no other workflow-runs query (§14 audit note). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7441-7459 (check at 7449, API filter at 7451) | severity=low (NIT) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The SUPERSEDED inference assumes the newer run cancelled this run's e2e-smoke-test, but the code never verifies it. The API call returns any newer run, including runs with a different `inputs.test_repo` (concurrency group at line 519), and a manual cancel also gives `E2E="cancelled"`.
  WHY: An operator who cancels manually, or whose runs use different `test_repo` values, is told the cause was the newer run and then chases the wrong run.
- HARDENING (not a defect): add a comment above the `gh api` call (lines 7450-7451) saying it is the only `gh api` in the step (§15 audit note). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7450-7458 | severity=low (NIT) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The SUPERSEDED message attributes the cancellation to the newer run, but the code only proves that a newer run exists. It does not verify that the newer run holds the `e2e-smoke-test-<repo>` concurrency slot.
  WHY: A manual cancel while any newer run exists (for any `test_repo`) gives a "follow the newer run" message instead of FAILED. The impact is message accuracy only.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:7440-7460 (lookup at 7450-7451; concurrency group at 518-519) | severity=low (NIT) | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The SUPERSEDED header proves only three weaker facts: the smoke test was cancelled, no other gate/validate/release job failed, and a higher-id run exists in the latest 20 runs. It does not check that the newer run shares the concurrency group or cancelled this one. `min` also picks the oldest newer run, which may not be the superseding one.
  WHY: A manual cancel while any newer dispatch exists (a different `test_repo`, or a `gate_only` run) produces a wrong SUPERSEDED message and misdirects triage. The impact is message accuracy only, and the lookup-error fallback stays FAILED.
- HARDENING (not a defect): add one comment above the new `gh api` call (lines 7434-7439) saying the notify step reads no other workflow-runs data (§14 audit note). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
